Subject: Questonix load window & k6 handoff — next steps

Hi Ryan / Asha — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your customer-led runbook exercised next week: 

1) Goals: validate 99th-pctl tail latency < 350ms for 1-2 concurrent streaming sessions per user, sustain 5k qps of short prompt generation across a 2m steady-state window, and verify graceful fallback to a smaller model under GPU slot pressure.
2) Proposed load window: Tue 2027-05-25 09:00–11:00 PT (we can move if you need evenings).
3) Artifacts: you mentioned you have a k6 profile and a Locust variant. Please drop the k6 script in the Drive folder we shared or attach here. We pulled together an initial k6 profile we think matches your traffic; please review.
4) IP allowlist & test accounts: we need the source IPs for your runners (or a CIDR) and one test account (API key with limited scope). We will provide ephemeral creds and an allowlist entry for the agent IPs at least 48 hours before the run.

Attached: questonix-k6-profile-v1.js (our initial adaptation), mutual-action-plan-Questonix-20270514.pdf

Next steps I suggest: Ben to confirm the run window and coordinate ops; Marissa to validate stream config and SLO gating; Ryan/Asha to share final k6 script and runner IPs by Tue 2027-05-18 EOD.

Thanks — Evelyn

Adding a couple logistic notes from my side: 

- I confirmed with Capacity that we can reserve an extra 4 inference slots on the us-west cluster during the window for the rehearsal so there is margin for the canary fallback test.
- Please confirm whether you want streaming enabled as chunked responses (faster first token) or full-response-only. The streaming SLOs differ; Evelyn / Marissa, can you call out what we should gate on?

Perfect, everyone — final checklist before the rehearsal: 

- Questonix to confirm final k6 profile in Drive by Tue 2027-05-18 EOD (we'll run a local dry-run once we pull it).
- Questonix to provide final runner IPs/CIDR 48h before the window (we have the three IPs attached but need official CIDR if different).

I'll create the run playbook page and share tonight: includes rollbacks, tracing keys, and the ToR for on-call. If anything changes call out asap.
